title: Rezoning map change for 132 Melrose Street, Brooklyn
summary: This application would change the zoning map to rezone 132-136 Melrose Street in Bushwick from an M1-1 manufacturing district to an M1-2A/R6A district with a Special Mixed Use District. It would help allow a new six-story mixed-use building with 18 apartments, including five permanently income-restricted units, and 6,000 square feet of ground-floor commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on the application on August 12, 2026.
